Our curriculum

We offer a broad and balanced curriculum that is ambitious for all pupils. Pupils study a wide range of subjects including English, mathematics, science, humanities and languages.

Our curriculum is carefully sequenced so that knowledge builds over time. We have high expectations and stretch pupils through challenging work.

Key Stage 4 options

At GCSE pupils can choose from art, drama, music, geography, history, French, Spanish, computer science and PE.
